notes: Hashes are md5 over the RAW pixel buffer (Image.GetData()), never over the saved PNG.
A GPU or driver change legitimately moves every hash at once; the gpu field above is what these were captured on. Regenerate after a driver update, and say so in the commit message.
A landed visual change updates this file in the SAME commit and names the shots it moved. An unexplained flip is a stop-the-line finding, not a regeneration.

exercises = what the shot covers TODAY, one sentence under 250 chars. REWRITE it on a re-pin, never append: no past-change deltas, no item ids, no dates. A commit hook enforces this. History is git log -p on this file; reasoning is the commit message.
The runner appends --screenshot=<abs path> and --log-file=<abs path>; everything else is the args below verbatim.

shots.name: c1-waterfall
shots.exercises: UV scroll on the falls sheet, the mist puffer carried on the mission wind and drawn farthest-first, the alpha-textured spray under the zone's world light, and the ridge's conifer cards blended rather than cut; frame-sensitive 1.28 % at 120 vs 121.

shots.name: c1b-night-sea
shots.exercises: night lighting, skydome, islands, coastline sheets dimmed by the 0.426 world light like every lit surface, the ambient cloud-puff field; static at 120 vs 121, 0.13 % at 120 vs 360 (puff drift).

shots.name: c1c-rain
shots.exercises: rain precipitation (seeded field on the sim clock), cloud deck, heavy fog; frame-sensitive 2.50 %.

shots.name: c2-city
shots.exercises: C2's solid 3D city blocks, backlot geometry, daylight fog, wake spray with far puffs culled, alpha sprites lit like the rest, Eiffel lattice and bridge cables blended not cut, two mesh point lights, no fade band; near-static, 51 px at 120 vs 121.

shots.name: c3-island
shots.exercises: coastline, surf edge and open water at close range, the blended surf sheets taking the world light with the water, and the distant spray and smoke puffs culled past their authored far band; static, 9 px at 120 vs 360.

shots.name: c4-snow
shots.exercises: snow precipitation plus the chapter carrying 6 UV-scroll models, with a stack plume culled past its authored far band and its near puffs on the mission wind; frame-sensitive 3.74 %, the largest of the freecam set.

shots.name: c5-city-night
shots.exercises: the night city: LIGHT_STATE point lights in csky_light_data, 51 beacons on their authored periods, lit window skins, the star field, the -0.8 mip LOD bias on every sampling arm, and torch puffs culled past their far band; one beacon toggles.

shots.name: c1-cloud-field
shots.exercises: the fvol cloud field along its own deck: sprites laid on the staggered lattice of each authored polygon face, each fading between both far_fade_range pairs against its own face's normal, the card colour, and the deck sheet past the field's edge.

shots.name: viewer-bhawk
shots.exercises: one aircraft built and painted: PlaneBuilder with the cockpit interior subtree the viewer lab builds, the default Fortune Hunters livery and decals, the orbit camera's framing, the launcher-default light; static by construction, 0 px at 30 vs 360.

shots.name: empty-stage
shots.exercises: Synthetic no-gamez flight: code-drawn grid, default sky and sun, quaternion attitude integration, chase camera and HUD, including the heading tape's uncapped ends, hem and rim fade; frame-sensitive 12.21 %, and renders with extracted/ absent.

shots.name: c1-flight-kill
shots.exercises: Chase-camera flight firing at two AIs then banking: one shot down 3 s earlier, its fireball and kill line up, the live one bracketed, the gun's smoke, tracers and shot light drawn on this frame's poses, exhaust, shadow; frame-sensitive 78.07 %.

shots.name: c1-cockpit
shots.exercises: Held pitch-and-roll flight seen from the pilot's seat: the cockpit1 interior in the pass's own SubViewport world under its re-aimed sun, needles, drum, belts and readouts, canopy frame and gunsight over world-lit C1; frame-sensitive 43.35 %.

shots.name: c1-destroy-effects
shots.exercises: Neutral-control player flight beside a killed ap_radiotwr: great_balls_of_fire on the world-effects stage riding its death site, the SpeedCue wisps spread across a 16:9 pane, seeded puffers, world-lit alpha scenery over water; frame-sensitive.

shots.name: c1-crash
shots.exercises: player_crash_default five steps in: corrected pre-crash attitude, crash rig and airframe, texture-flag puffers, ranged tumble, vector pieces, flydirt delta, pooled repeats, the crash notice and respawn prompt over the hidden HUD, on lit C1 scenery.

shots.name: c1-debris-rest
shots.exercises: the two-ray column ground-contact tier: a killed hangar's flung debris tested against terrain, one piece resting with its landing's own spark puffer, on the mission wind, as the visible signal, over C1 ground and cutouts under one world light.

shots.name: c1-stunt-marker
shots.exercises: A stunt run's Danger Zone off screen on the pilot's own target cycle: the spyglass disc at the marker anchor, the shaft leaving its rim under the 20-by-10 head, the label in the objective's blue, the run clock, the plane's ground shadow below.

shots.name: campaign-4p-grid
shots.exercises: Four humans launch a co-op campaign mission on StartGrid with no profile to load, so no director: four render targets, HUDs, gauges and target labels, the lit C1 world, the player-shaped shadow under each pane's own pilot; frame-sensitive 73.79%.

shots.name: campaign-intro-fill
shots.exercises: A campaign mission's intro cutscene fills the whole window at four human players: one pane at the full rect, the film fitted by the card's height with the bars stretched across it, the rest hidden, the lit C1 scene behind; frame-sensitive 3.89%.

shots.name: menu-original-flag
shots.exercises: The Original top level over its decoded layout: the CrimFlag movie decoded from the install's own MPEG-1 as the backmost layer at the row's 250 percent, the logo, button frame and plaques over it, and the build stamp in the corner.
